scope: Additional full-character surface review after the first v004 PC capture, before final delivery

rejected.method: 2048 further Taubin iterations with larger displacement caps
rejected.reason: Actual clay renders worsened eye-surround transitions and foot contours; not applied to delivery asset.

rejected.method: Extend rest fairing to nearly the entire foot with stronger stable smoothing
rejected.reason: Rounded-foot identity became an angular flat-bottom contour in comparison. Rejected; retain approved sole region.

rejected.method: Stronger whole-surface low-pass with global bounding-box compensation
rejected.reason: Preserving overall bounds did not preserve appearance: the eye surroundings exposed a different rim and the facial depth changed. Rejected; no global fit or larger displacement adopted.

selected: Bounded low-pass rest cleanup, 24/32/48 iterations according to mesh, smooth tanh displacement limits, W/eye/nose and soles protected. Ignore isolated unused vertices in adjacency. Actual pose corrections use a separate balanced fairing pass and the causal belly displacement-field repair.
limits: Selection is an agent geometry comparison, not Human aesthetic approval. All body regions and pose transitions remain in the Human re-review scope. No claim of exhaustive certification for infinitely many continuous control combinations.
